problems.statementHtml: Mary thought of a positive two-digit number. She multiplied it by \(3\) and added \(11.\) Then she switched the digits of the result, obtaining a number between \(71\) and \(75,\) inclusive. What was Mary’s number?
problems.statementZhHtml: Mary 想了一个正的两位数。她把它乘以 \(3\)，再加上 \(11\)。然后她交换所得结果的两个数字，得到一个介于 \(71\) 和 \(75\) 之间（含端点）的数。Mary 原来的数是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Sofia ran \(5\) laps around the \(400\)-meter track at her school. For each lap, she ran the first \(100\) meters at an average speed of \(4\) meters per second and the remaining \(300\) meters at an average speed of \(5\) meters per second. How much time did Sofia take running the \(5\) laps?
problems.statementZhHtml: Sofia 在学校的 \(400\) 米跑道上跑了 \(5\) 圈。每一圈中，她前 \(100\) 米的平均速度为每秒 \(4\) 米，剩下 \(300\) 米的平均速度为每秒 \(5\) 米。Sofia 跑完 \(5\) 圈共花了多少时间？

problems.statementHtml:
Real numbers \(x,\) \(y,\) and \(z\) satisfy the inequalities \(0 < x < 1,\) \(-1 < y < 0,\) and \(1 < z < 2.\)

Which of the following numbers is necessarily positive?
Suppose that \(x\) and \(y\) are nonzero real numbers such that \[\frac{3x+y}{x-3y}=-2.\] What is the value of \[\frac{x+3y}{3x-y}?\]
problems.statementZhHtml: 设 \(x\) 和 \(y\) 是非零实数，且满足 \[\frac{3x+y}{x-3y}=-2\text{。}\] 求下式的值： \[\frac{x+3y}{3x-y}\text{。}\]

problems.statementHtml: Camilla had twice as many blueberry jelly beans as cherry jelly beans. After eating \(10\) pieces of each kind, she now has three times as many blueberry jelly beans as cherry jelly beans. How many blueberry jelly beans did she originally have?
problems.statementZhHtml: Camilla 原来拥有的蓝莓味软糖数量是樱桃味软糖数量的两倍。她每种各吃了 \(10\) 颗后，蓝莓味软糖数量变成樱桃味软糖数量的三倍。她原来有多少颗蓝莓味软糖？

problems.statementHtml: What is the largest number of solid \(2\)-in \(\times\) \(2\)-in \(\times\) \(1\)-in blocks that can fit in a \(3\)-in \(\times\) \(2\)-in \(\times\) \(3\)-in box?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个 \(3\) 英寸 \(\times\) \(2\) 英寸 \(\times\) \(3\) 英寸的盒子中，最多能放入多少个实心的 \(2\) 英寸 \(\times\) \(2\) 英寸 \(\times\) \(1\) 英寸长方体？

problems.statementHtml:
Samia set off on her bicycle to visit her friend, traveling at an average speed of \(17\) kilometers per hour. When she had gone half the distance to her friend’s house, a tire went flat, and she walked the rest of the way at \(5\) kilometers per hour.

In all, it took her \(44\) minutes to reach her friend’s house. In kilometers rounded to the nearest tenth, how far did Samia walk?
problems.statementZhHtml:
Samia 骑自行车去拜访朋友，平均速度为每小时 \(17\) 千米。当她走完到朋友家的路程的一半时，轮胎漏气了，于是她以每小时 \(5\) 千米的速度走完剩下的一半路程。

她总共花了 \(44\) 分钟到达朋友家。四舍五入到最接近的十分之一千米，Samia 走了多远？

problems.statementHtml: Points \(A(11, 9)\) and \(B(2, -3)\) are vertices of \(\triangle ABC\) with \(AB=AC.\) The altitude from \(A\) meets the opposite side at \(D(-1, 3).\) What are the coordinates of point \(C?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 点 \(A(11, 9)\) 和 \(B(2, -3)\) 是 \(\triangle ABC\) 的顶点，且 \(AB=AC\)。从 \(A\) 作到底边的高，与对边交于 \(D(-1, 3)\)。点 \(C\) 的坐标是什么？

problems.statementHtml: A radio program has a quiz consisting of \(3\) multiple-choice questions, each with \(3\) choices. A contestant wins if he or she gets \(2\) or more of the questions right. The contestant answers randomly to each question. What is the probability of winning?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个广播节目有一个由 \(3\) 道选择题组成的测验，每题有 \(3\) 个选项。参赛者答对 \(2\) 题或更多即获胜。参赛者随机回答每一道题。获胜的概率是多少？

problems.statementHtml: The lines with equations \(ax-2y=c\) and \(2x+by=-c\) are perpendicular and intersect at \((1, -5).\) What is \(c?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 方程为 \(ax-2y=c\) 和 \(2x+by=-c\) 的两条直线互相垂直，并且相交于 \((1, -5)\)。\(c\) 的值是多少？

problems.statementHtml: At Typico High School, \(60\%\) of the students like dancing, and the rest dislike it. Of those who like dancing, \(80\%\) say that they like it, and the rest say that they dislike it. Of those who dislike dancing, \(90\%\) say that they dislike it, and the rest say that they like it. What fraction of students who say they dislike dancing actually like it?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在 Typico 高中，\(60\%\) 的学生喜欢跳舞，其余学生不喜欢。在真正喜欢跳舞的人中，\(80\%\) 说他们喜欢，剩下的人说他们不喜欢。在真正不喜欢跳舞的人中，\(90\%\) 说他们不喜欢，剩下的人说他们喜欢。那些说自己不喜欢跳舞的学生中，实际喜欢跳舞的占多少比例？

problems.statementHtml: Elmer’s new car gets \(50\%\) better fuel efficiency, measured in kilometers per liter, than his old car. However, his new car uses diesel fuel, which is \(20\%\) more expensive per liter than the gasoline his old car uses. By what percent will Elmer save money if he uses his new car instead of his old car for a long trip?
problems.statementZhHtml: Elmer 的新车燃油效率（以每升行驶千米数衡量）比旧车高 \(50\%\)。不过新车使用柴油，柴油每升价格比旧车使用的汽油贵 \(20\%\)。如果 Elmer 长途旅行时使用新车而不是旧车，他会省下百分之多少的钱？

problems.statementHtml:
There are \(20\) students participating in an after-school program offering classes in yoga, bridge, and painting. Each student must take at least one of these three classes, but may take two or all three.

There are \(10\) students taking yoga, \(13\) taking bridge, and \(9\) taking painting. There are \(9\) students taking at least two classes. How many students are taking all three classes?
problems.statementZhHtml:
有 \(20\) 名学生参加课后项目，该项目提供瑜伽、桥牌和绘画课程。每名学生至少选一门课，也可以选两门或三门。

有 \(10\) 人选瑜伽，\(13\) 人选桥牌，\(9\) 人选绘画。有 \(9\) 人至少选了两门课。选了三门课的学生有多少人？

problems.statementHtml: An integer \(N\) is selected at random in the range \(1\leq N \leq 2020\) . What is the probability that the remainder when \(N^{16}\) is divided by \(5\) is \(1?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 从 \(1\leq N \leq 2020\) 的整数中随机选一个整数 \(N\)。\(N^{16}\) 除以 \(5\) 的余数为 \(1\) 的概率是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Rectangle \(ABCD\) has \(AB=3\) and \(BC=4.\) Point \(E\) is the foot of the perpendicular from \(B\) to diagonal \(\overline{AC}.\) What is the area of \(\triangle ADE?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 长方形 \(ABCD\) 中，\(AB=3\)，\(BC=4\)。点 \(E\) 是从 \(B\) 向对角线 \(\overline{AC}\) 所作垂线的垂足。求 \(\triangle ADE\) 的面积。

problems.statementHtml: How many of the base-ten numerals for the positive integers less than or equal to \(2017\) contain the digit \(0?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 小于或等于 \(2017\) 的正整数中，十进制表示含有数字 \(0\) 的有多少个？

problems.statementHtml: Call a positive integer monotonous if it is a one-digit number or its digits, when read from left to right, form either a strictly increasing or a strictly decreasing sequence. For example, \(3,\) \(23578,\) and \(987620\) are monotonous, but \(88,\) \(7434,\) and \(23557\) are not. How many monotonous positive integers are there?
problems.statementZhHtml: 若一个正整数是一位数，或者它的数字从左到右读时构成严格递增或严格递减的序列，则称它为 单调数。例如 \(3\)、\(23578\) 和 \(987620\) 是单调数，但 \(88\)、\(7434\) 和 \(23557\) 不是。共有多少个单调正整数？

problems.statementHtml: In the figure below, \(3\) of the \(6\) disks are to be painted blue, \(2\) are to be painted red, and \(1\) is to be painted green. Two paintings that can be obtained from one another by a rotation or a reflection of the entire figure are considered the same. How many different paintings are possible?
problems.statementZhHtml: 在下图中，\(6\) 个圆盘中有 \(3\) 个要涂成蓝色，\(2\) 个要涂成红色，\(1\) 个要涂成绿色。如果两个涂色方案可以通过整个图形的旋转或反射相互得到，则视为相同。共有多少种不同涂法？

problems.statementHtml:
Let \(ABC\) be an equilateral triangle. Extend side \(\overline{AB}\) beyond \(B\) to a point \(B'\) so that \(BB'=3 \cdot AB.\) Similarly, extend side \(\overline{BC}\) beyond \(C\) to a point \(C'\) so that \(CC'=3 \cdot BC,\) and extend side \(\overline{CA}\) beyond \(A\) to a point \(A'\) so that \(AA'=3 \cdot CA.\)

What is the ratio of the area of \(\triangle A'B'C'\) to the area of \(\triangle ABC?\)
problems.statementZhHtml:
设 \(ABC\) 是等边三角形。将边 \(\overline{AB}\) 过 \(B\) 延长到点 \(B'\)，使 \(BB'=3 \cdot AB\)。类似地，将 \(\overline{BC}\) 过 \(C\) 延长到 \(C'\)，使 \(CC'=3 \cdot BC\)，将 \(\overline{CA}\) 过 \(A\) 延长到 \(A'\)，使 \(AA'=3 \cdot CA\)。

\(\triangle A'B'C'\) 的面积与 \(\triangle ABC\) 的面积之比是多少？

problems.statementHtml: The number \(21!\) \(=51{,}090{,}942{,}171{,}709{,}440{,}000\) has over \(60{,}000\) positive integer divisors. One of them is chosen at random. What is the probability that it is odd?
In \(\triangle ABC,\) \(AB=6,\) \(AC=8,\) \(BC=10,\) and \(D\) is the midpoint of \(\overline{BC}.\) What is the sum of the radii of the circles inscribed in \(\triangle ADB\) and \(\triangle ADC?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 在 \(\triangle ABC\) 中，\(AB=6\)，\(AC=8\)，\(BC=10\)，且 \(D\) 是 \(\overline{BC}\) 的中点。求 \(\triangle ADB\) 与 \(\triangle ADC\) 内切圆半径之和。

problems.statementHtml: The diameter \(\overline{AB}\) of a circle of radius \(2\) is extended to a point \(D\) outside the circle so that \(BD=3.\) Point \(E\) is chosen so that \(ED=5\) and line \(ED\) is perpendicular to line \(AD.\) Segment \(\overline{AE}\) intersects the circle at a point \(C\) between \(A\) and \(E.\) What is the area of \(\triangle ABC?\)
problems.statementZhHtml: 半径为 \(2\) 的圆的直径 \(\overline{AB}\) 延长到圆外一点 \(D\)，使 \(BD=3\)。点 \(E\) 满足 \(ED=5\)，且直线 \(ED\) 垂直于直线 \(AD\)。线段 \(\overline{AE}\) 与圆交于位于 \(A\) 和 \(E\) 之间的点 \(C\)。求 \(\triangle ABC\) 的面积。

problems.statementHtml: Let \[N=123456789101112\dots4344\] be the \(79\)-digit number that is formed by writing the integers from \(1\) to \(44\) in order, one after the other. What is the remainder when \(N\) is divided by \(45?\)
The vertices of an equilateral triangle lie on the hyperbola \(xy=1,\) and a vertex of this hyperbola is the centroid of the triangle. What is the square of the area of the triangle?
problems.statementZhHtml: 一个等边三角形的三个顶点都在双曲线 \(xy=1\) 上，并且该双曲线的一个顶点是这个三角形的重心。这个三角形面积的平方是多少？

problems.statementHtml: Last year Isabella took \(7\) math tests and received \(7\) different scores, each an integer between \(91\) and \(100,\) inclusive. After each test she noticed that the average of her test scores was an integer. Her score on the seventh test was \(95.\) What was her score on the sixth test?
problems.statementZhHtml: 去年 Isabella 参加了 \(7\) 次数学考试，得到了 \(7\) 个不同的分数，每个分数都是 \(91\) 到 \(100\) 之间（含端点）的整数。每次考试后，她都注意到到目前为止考试分数的平均数是整数。她第七次考试得了 \(95\) 分。她第六次考试得了多少分？
